description: Persistent Agent is a proactive, always-on, goal-oriented agent. Think Muse or Instinct, but for the enterprise. Comes with memory, browser use, hundreds of tools, and proactive playbooks it can run in the background to take work off your plate. Built on Managed Deep Agents (MDA).
